The evidence suggests that Vincoside Lactam may exert its biological effects through multiple pathways, ultimately influencing the expression of the Macrophage-expressed gene 1 protein. The strength of the evidence is moderate, with varying scores across the different targets, but the consistent targeting of the gene from multiple pathways supports a plausible mechanism.
